大家好!我是《逆仙成魔传》的作者废个球，想必大家看到这个公告会感到非常意外，大家可能会想：废个球几个月不更新了估计是凉了，这个小说多半废了。
其实不然，我废个球虽然的的确确几个月没有更新了，但是，我一直没有放弃写作生涯，也没有放弃作家这个职业。
废个球之所以没有更新，那是因为我去进修学习去了，去文学院进一步学习如何更好的写小说……经过这几个月的艰苦奋斗，废个球感觉自身实力大幅度提升，又要开始更新作品了。
总而言之，《逆仙成魔传》继续连载!欢迎大家来看，和我一起见证主角李磊的成长!
谢谢大家!对了!不知道你们喜不喜欢科幻末日机甲题材的作品，废个球打算搞他一波。

The latest chapter of The Legend of Reverse Immortal and Become a Demon_Serial Announcement Page 1_The Legend of Reverse Immortal and Become a Demon is a waste_Hot Novel Network
Hello everyone! I am Fei Geqiu, the author of "The Legend of Reversing Immortals and Becoming Demons". I think you will be very surprised when you see this announcement. You may think: Fei Geqiu has not been updated for a few months, so it must have become cold. This novel is probably useless.
In fact, this is not the case. Although it is true that I have not updated for several months, I have never given up on my writing career, nor on my career as a writer.
The reason why Feigeqiu has not been updated is because I went to study for further studies, and went to the School of Liberal Arts to further learn how to write novels better... After these few months of hard work, Feigeqiu feels that my strength has greatly improved, and I will start updating my works again.
All in all, "The Legend of the Immortal and the Demon" continues to be serialized! Everyone is welcome to watch and witness the growth of the protagonist Li Lei with me!
Thank you everyone! By the way! I don’t know if you like sci-fi doomsday mecha-themed works, so I’m going to give it a try.
